name: Disintegrate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature, nonmagical object or creation of magical force you can see

summary: A green ray: Dex save or 10d6 + 40 Force; a creature it drops to 0 Hit Points turns to dust.
text: It can also destroy a nonmagical object or a 10-foot cube of it, or a creation of magical force such as a Wall of Force.
